# Perfect Pixel Pro

> Perfect Pixel Pro is a creative design and brand marketing agency with offices in Mohali, India and Edmonton, Canada. We work with brands on product commercialization, creative campaigns, brand awareness, and event management and marketing — combining market research, visual identity systems, and production into work that is strategic before it is decorative.

The agency's method is built around three stages it calls Prediction, Penetration and Precision: research the market and audience before anything is designed, translate those findings into a visual system that works across every surface, then obsess over the execution details. Founded by Deepak Khatri, the team serves clients across North America and India in sectors including retail, consumer goods, real estate, technology and hospitality.

Primary contact: Info@perfectpixelpro.com
Offices: Sector 75, Phase 8b, Mohali, India · 1798 Lakewood Rd S NW, Edmonton, AB T6K 3B6, Canada

## Services

- [Product Commercialization](https://perfectpixelpro.com/product-commercialization): A buyer-first guide to taking a product from ready-to-sell to actually selling — positioning, pricing narrative, channel strategy and launch assets.
- [Creative Campaigns](https://perfectpixelpro.com/creative-campaigns): Campaign strategy and creative development — the insight, the idea, and the full asset system that carries it across channels.
- [Building Brand Awareness](https://perfectpixelpro.com/building-brand-awareness): Making a brand recognizable and memorable through consistent identity, distinctive assets and sustained presence.
- [Event Management & Marketing](https://perfectpixelpro.com/event-management-and-marketing): End-to-end event design, production and the marketing campaign that fills the room.
- [Product Launch](https://perfectpixelpro.com/product-launch): A week-by-week launch runway covering pre-launch, launch day and the weeks that decide whether momentum holds.
- [Product Sales](https://perfectpixelpro.com/product-sales): Diagnosing where a funnel leaks and fixing the conversion path between interest and purchase.
- [Pre-Product Assistance](https://perfectpixelpro.com/pre-product-assistance): Validating an idea with real market signal before engineering and inventory money is committed.
